blocks.text: Reports provide a structured way to analyze and present data in the Agentic Security Operations Platform (Agentic SecOps Platform). You can create reports focused on key entities such as users, tenants, identity findings, tickets, and assets, and customize them with relevant parameters, measurements, and dimensions to highlight specific trends or areas of concern. Reports can be processed manually or scheduled for automatic delivery, helping you track progress, support audits, and keep stakeholders informed.

blocks.item: In the Agentic SecOps Platform Admin Portal, go to Explore > Reports.
Alternatively, you can go to:
Vulnerabilities > My Reports
Assets > My Reports
Identities > My Reports
SOC Workbench > My Reports
A list of the reports that you have access to appears.
See image.
Click New.
See image.
A new report page appears.
Click the Edit icon.
See image.
The Edit Report Details window appears.
In the Edit Report Details window:
Name: Enter a name for the report.
Viewers: Select the users who can view the report.
Public: Select this option to grant view access to all users in the account.
Selected Users: Select specific users to set them as viewers.
To keep the report private, leave the Viewers drop-down menu blank.
Editors: Select the users who can edit the report.
Public: Select to grant edit access to all users in the account.
Selected Users: Select specific users that can edit the report. The edit access overrides the view access.
To keep the report private, leave the Viewers drop-down menu blank.
Pin to Apps: (Optional) Select the application in the Agentic SecOps Platform to which you want to pin the report.
See image.
Tags: Add one or more tags to categorize the report and make it easier to search and organize.
Close the window.
Select the data type for your report.
At the top of the page, set the date filter to either Current or History.
See image.
For historical reports, click the date filter to specify the desired date range. You can select a preconfigured range, create a custom range, or set a dynamic range. To learn more, see Using Filters.
See image.
Customize the report's displayed data and filters.
Configure the data displayed in the report.
(Optional) Apply filters to the report.
Save the report in one of the following ways:
Click Done to save and close the report, redirecting you to the Reports page.
Click Save to save the report. If scheduled, the report exports at the set time.
Select Save & Run from the Save drop-down menu to save the report and immediately apply export settings, if configured.
Select Save As New from the Save drop-down menu to save your changes as a new report.

blocks.text: You can take the following actions with reports:

blocks.item: View reports directly in the Agentic SecOps Platform.
Manually download reports.
Schedule reports for automated delivery.
Trigger report exports programmatically via an API.
